scope: Instant-runoff voting CosmWasm contract + TDX enclave tabulation; greenfield methodology dogfood
_source: Facts drawn from fv's own docs (README.md 'Dogfood projects' table and methodology-improvements.md). No field here was captured from the verified-rcv repo at run time; every value not stated in those docs is null. status=observation because the load-bearing bindings (commit, hashes, seeds, raw-report hashes, bounds) were never recorded.

commits.note: Contract deployed to testnet and enclave exercised as uncommitted spike work; no commit was pinned at evidence time. fv-evidence-run/v3 records bind source as a verified-input content snapshot (sha256:<hex>, suffixed +dirty when a non-excluded path is modified), not as a commit id; no snapshot was computed for these runs.

intent.note: Current intent is v0.3.15; the integration ledger was generated at v0.3.5 and is stale (README). Intent hash was never captured. path is the repo-relative canonical target a v3 record carries as bindings.intent_path; it is resolved from .fv/dispatch.json omp_native.target_spec, which verified-rcv never declared, so the default .fv/intent.md applied.

specs.note: Quint protocol model; not extended when the registry-rotation timelock landed (a known gap).
Lean spec layer set up as a Lake project (Mathlib + VCV-io + ArkLib); per-file hashes never captured.

commands.note: Dispatched at --variant high; exact command lines were not recorded. See also revised_canonical_critique.py.
10 Kani harnesses, all targeting IRV result structure; no attestation/registry/gnark/serialization harnesses (bottom-up catalog gap).

tool_versions.note: Values mirror bom.json at manifest time. The exact tool versions used during the verified-rcv runs were not recorded; these are the current pins, not a captured run environment.

model_versions._cite: registry/voices.json (forthcoming; not present in the tree at authoring time)
model_versions.note: Adversarial rounds used frontier + local voices at --variant high (families named generically in methodology-improvements.md), but per-run voice IDs and versions were never captured. The machine-readable voice registry (C4) is forthcoming; cite it here once it lands.

bounds.note: Bounded-check depths (Apalache max-steps, Kani unwind) were not recorded per run.

seeds.note: quint run seeds for the adversarial-trace searches were not recorded.

raw_reports.note: Attack reports live under the project's .fv/attacks/; individual report hashes were never captured.
Integration ledger; stale at intent v0.3.5.

canonical_paths_exercised.evidence: Intent authored and revised to v0.3.15; encoding-discipline notes added at v0.3.1/v0.3.2.
Lean spec layer complete via Lake project (specs/lakefile.lean).
Cross-critique, defense, and re-cross-critique rounds dispatched at --variant high; caught tautological-shadow, scope-name, and coverage-hole defects.
10 harnesses over IRV result structure; trust-boundary surfaces uncovered.
NOT run when the registry-rotation timelock landed; auditor later found a multi-tx DoS sequence a lifecycle-adversary pass would have caught.
NOT run; 8 of 13 high-severity audit findings would have been caught by the six-lens code-adversarial stage.
Ledger generated at intent v0.3.5; stale vs current v0.3.15, regeneration pending in the verified-rcv repo.

evidence_records.note: verified-rcv predates fv-evidence-run/v3: no hash-bound per-claim record was ever produced, so there is nothing to point at. A manifested project lists one record per required obligation here - invariants and witnesses with the tool that discharged them, system claims with the required_evidence tool IDs their execution cohort covers - and every listed record must validate under scripts/check_evidence_records.py at the snapshot above. Record shape: docs/dogfood-evidence.md.

verification_plan.note: No declarative plan was authored; the pyramid ran on built-in defaults. A manifested project names its .fv/verification-plan.json here so the exact argv, cwd, timeout, and env of every layer execution is reconstructible. Example: scripts/verification-plan.example.json.

notes: This is a dogfood OBSERVATION, not a manifested evidence base. Per the rule in docs/dogfood-evidence.md, verified-rcv may be described only as a dogfood observation until a status=manifested manifest (real commit, hashes, seeds, raw-report hashes, bounds) exists. Regenerating the verified-rcv integration ledger against the current intent is pending work in that project's own repo and is out of scope for the fv repo.
